verdict.rationale: Adyen documents building against the Agentic Commerce Protocol (ACP) and Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP), including tokens, sessions and UCP envelopes. Adyen also publishes OpenAPI definitions on GitHub, though the evidence does not tie them specifically to the agentic APIs, and the docs-site OpenAPI probe returned 404. Missing for 10: explicit protocol versioning, a published schema clearly covering the agentic ACP/UCP endpoints, and any conformance or validation tooling.
